summary: BuzzFeed, Inc. filed Form 8-K to disclose an amendment (Fourth Amended Credit Agreement) to its existing credit facility. The amendment extends a $5.0 million payment due April 30, 2026, to May 18, 2026, and establishes incremental mandatory prepayments from specified asset sales or equity issuances while maintaining $7.5 million liquidity. A $0.5 million debt modification fee is payable upon certain events. Failure to pay could trigger an event of default. No prices, premiums, or deal structure are stated. The filing represents a routine debt restructuring to manage near-term obligations, not a special situation like acquisitions or divestitures. Watch for further amendments or defaults.
